</div>

**Returns** <span class="sdk-type">Promise&lt;boolean&gt;</span>

**Example**

```ts

const claimed = mine && (await obol.incentives.isClaimed({ contractAddress: mine.contractAddress, index: mine.index }));
```

### incentives.preflight {#preflight}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag" title="Where it reads from (spec tag)">api+chain (API data, every check on chain)</span> <a class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--stage" href="../lifecycle#distribute">8. Distribute and claim</a></div>

Runs every check of `prepareClaim` and returns `{ ok, issues }` instead of throwing:
the distributor code, Merkle root and proof on chain, the claim window, the token.

```ts sdk-signature
obol.incentives.preflight(
  address: string,
): Promise<PreflightResult>
```

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--fields">

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <code>address</code> | <span class="sdk-type">string</span> |  |

</div>

**Returns** <span class="sdk-type">Promise&lt;<a href="./types/incentives#PreflightResult">PreflightResult</a>&gt;</span>

**Example**

```ts
const check = await obol.incentives.preflight(account); // every claim check, nothing sent
if (!check.ok) console.log(check.issues.map(i => i.code));
```

<details class="sdk-spec">
<summary>Specification: incentives.prepareClaim (shared section)</summary>

Tag: `api+chain` (API data, every check on chain). Input: `address`. (2.15 `preflightIncentivesClaim`)

Checks; each failure is an issue `{ code, message, hint }`:

1. [`incentives.get`](./incentives.md#get): 404 → [`INCENTIVES_NOT_FOUND`](../warnings.md#INCENTIVES_NOT_FOUND); other API error → [`INCENTIVES_FETCH_FAILED`](../warnings.md#INCENTIVES_FETCH_FAILED); empty record →
   [`NO_INCENTIVES`](../warnings.md#NO_INCENTIVES).
2. `operatorAddress` equals `address` ([`OPERATOR_ADDRESS_MISMATCH`](../warnings.md#OPERATOR_ADDRESS_MISMATCH)); contract address, index (safe non-negative
   integer), amount (decimal integer), proof (32-byte hashes) well-formed ([`INCENTIVES_DATA_INVALID`](../warnings.md#INCENTIVES_DATA_INVALID)). Stop here if any.
3. The contract has code ([`CONTRACT_NOT_DEPLOYED`](../warnings.md#CONTRACT_NOT_DEPLOYED)) and its code, with the 8 immutables and the metadata trailer zeroed,
   hashes to the reference build ([`DISTRIBUTOR_UNKNOWN`](../warnings.md#DISTRIBUTOR_UNKNOWN)). Stop here if any.
4. `token()` is the chain's OBOL token ([`TOKEN_MISMATCH`](../warnings.md#TOKEN_MISMATCH)).
5. Folding the proof (sorted-pair keccak256) over `keccak256(abi.encodePacked(uint256 index, address account, uint256
amount))` gives `merkleRoot()` (`PROOF_INVALID`).
6. `isClaimed(index)` ([`ALREADY_CLAIMED`](../errors.md#ALREADY_CLAIMED)); latest block timestamp ≤ `endTime()` ([`CLAIM_WINDOW_CLOSED`](../warnings.md#CLAIM_WINDOW_CLOSED);
   [`CHAIN_READ_FAILED`](../errors.md#CHAIN_READ_FAILED) if the block cannot be read).

Outcome: only [`ALREADY_CLAIMED`](../errors.md#ALREADY_CLAIMED) (possibly with [`CLAIM_WINDOW_CLOSED`](../warnings.md#CLAIM_WINDOW_CLOSED)) → throw [`ALREADY_CLAIMED`](../errors.md#ALREADY_CLAIMED) (nothing to do; treat
as success). Any other issue → [`INCENTIVES_PREFLIGHT_FAILED`](../errors.md#INCENTIVES_PREFLIGHT_FAILED) with `issues`. Otherwise
`Prepared<"claim">` (preview `{ amount, contractAddress }`) calling `claim(index, account, amount, merkleProof)`.

`incentives.preflight(address)` returns `{ ok, issues }` from the same checks without throwing. (2.15 `preflightClaim`)

<p class="sdk-muted">From <a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/spec/operations.md">spec/operations.md</a>.</p>

</details>

### incentives.prepareClaim {#prepareClaim}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag" title="Where it reads from (spec tag)">api+chain (API data, every check on chain)</span> <span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--throws">throws 3</span> <a class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--stage" href="../lifecycle#distribute">8. Distribute and claim</a></div>

Prepares the claim of `address`'s incentives. A failed check: INCENTIVES_PREFLIGHT_FAILED
(details.issues); already claimed: ALREADY_CLAIMED.

```ts sdk-signature
obol.incentives.prepareClaim(
  address: string,
): Promise<Prepared<'claim'>>
```

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--fields">

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <code>address</code> | <span class="sdk-type">string</span> |  |

</div>

**Returns** <span class="sdk-type">Promise&lt;<a href="./types/send#Prepared">Prepared</a>&lt;'claim'&gt;&gt;</span>: a `Prepared` of kind `'claim'`, preview <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/send#PreviewByKind">PreviewByKind</a>['claim']</span>. Send it with [`obol.send`](./send.md#send) or your wallet layer.

**Throws** <span class="sdk-muted">(per spec)</span> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#CHAIN_READ_FAILED">CHAIN_READ_FAILED</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#INCENTIVES_PREFLIGHT_FAILED">INCENTIVES_PREFLIGHT_FAILED</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#ALREADY_CLAIMED">ALREADY_CLAIMED</a> <span class="sdk-muted">plus the [checks every operation runs](../errors.md#checks-every-operation-runs)</span>

**Example**

```ts
const claim = await obol.incentives.prepareClaim(account); // INCENTIVES_PREFLIGHT_FAILED, ALREADY_CLAIMED
await (await obol.send(claim)).wait();
```
